# 5 groups of 4 vertices each
groups = [list(range(4*i, 4*i+4)) for i in range(5)]

edges = set()
# Within each group, all edges (clique)

    for i, j in itertools.combinations(g, 2):
        edges.add((i, j) if i < j else (j, i))

# Between adjacent groups (i and i+1 mod 5), all edges

    g1 = groups[i]
    g2 = groups[(i+1) % 5]
    for v1 in g1:
        for v2 in g2:
            edges.add((v1, v2) if v1 < v2 else (v2, v1))
